sources.title: Longitudinal and cross-sectional evidence that daily resting and activity energy expenditures are independent in humans
sources.populationAndWindow: 12 adults: two 10-day activity periods; separate 268-adult baseline cohort.
sources.measurement: DLW and calorimetry; wearable activity proxy and derived activity estimates have distinct roles.
sources.finding: No mass-adjusted resting suppression identified in the reported comparisons.
sources.limitations: Small, brief intervention; unsupervised activity, long washout and residual measurement error. No long-term or clinical generalization.

sources.title: Multilevel metabolic adaptation to exercise training
sources.populationAndWindow: 16 sedentary adults with overweight; 12-week supervised walking.
sources.measurement: DLW, whole-room calorimetry, MRI and activity measures.
sources.finding: Reported resting/sleeping reductions alongside higher total expenditure provide contrary adaptation evidence.
sources.limitations: Small selected cohort; no concurrent human control; mouse findings do not establish human causality or a universal factor.
